blazers.pulse: Portland is 2-0 after a 128-120 win in Sacramento, but this one wasn't pretty. The Blazers trailed by 12 early and needed a 44-point third quarter to pull away, and Blazer's Edge called the defense a 'wax museum' as the Kings drove right at Dame and Ja. Fans will take the W and worry about the defense later.
storylines: Deni Avdija led the way with 26 points, 6 rebounds and 6 assists; Lillard and Toumani Camara had 19 each
A 15-0 third-quarter run flipped it, and Portland iced it at the line after Sacramento got within 121-118
Defense was the worry: Sabonis put up 27, 19 and 10, and Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scored 33
Shooting was streaky, 14 of 49 from three overall
Next up: at the Lakers on Tuesday

timbers.pulse: Tonight might be the last real shot. The Timbers are winless in seven, 11th in the West and five points behind Colorado for the last playoff spot with four games left. They host Charlotte, who can clinch its own playoff berth, so fans want a win and don't expect much.
storylines: Charlotte at Providence Park tonight, 7:30 PT
34 points from 30 games, with seven straight games without a win
Charlotte has won both previous meetings
One preview predicts a 1-1 draw, which wouldn't be enough

f1.pulse: Ferrari owned Friday in Austin. Charles Leclerc topped both practices, but Kimi Antonelli was only 0.042s behind in FP2, so his title-clinching weekend is still on track. Qualifying is today and the race is Sunday.
storylines: Antonelli wins the title Sunday with a win if Russell is 9th or lower and Hamilton is 5th or lower; he leads Russell by 102
Leclerc led FP1 and FP2, with Verstappen 2nd in FP1 and 3rd in FP2; Russell was 5th in FP2
Antonelli pitted in practice to fix a seat that was moving too much
Stewards cleared Russell after a moment where Leclerc went off track
The bumpy COTA surface kept tripping drivers up on their qualifying sims
